package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 3-day Jordan adventure through Amman, Ajloun, and Jerash - curated with authentic local experiences and expert guides.
package.trip_title: Amman, Ajloun & Jerash - History & Culture Tour

trip.title: Amman, Ajloun & Jerash - History & Culture Tour
trip.summary: Three days of historic exploration and cultural immersion, each day focused on a single region. Morning walks in the heat, afternoon shade and dining, and a comfortable 4-star stay in Amman.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Amman, Ajloun, then Jerash. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.

climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

days.summary: Afternoon arrival in Amman: lunch, then rest. A quiet first evening.

schedule.name: InterContinental Jordan
schedule.description: Long-established five-star IHG hotel on Islamic College Street in Jabal Amman, between the Second and Third Circles, with six restaurants, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and a 24-hour reception.
schedule.reason: Check in and rest through the hot / tired hours. Keep the first evening easy. 5-star stay, as requested

schedule.name: Sufra Restaurant
schedule.description: An award-winning upscale Jordanian restaurant on Rainbow Street serving authentic heritage recipes in a gorgeous villa.
schedule.reason: A simple dinner if the kitchen is still open, then sleep.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

days.transport_notes: You land at 15:50. The drive from Queen Alia to Amman is about 45 minutes. Times below start after that transfer.

days.summary: Explore Ajloun's natural beauty and medieval fortress, then enjoy local Jordanian cuisine in the forest reserve.

schedule.name: Al-Karakah Nature Trail
schedule.description: Peaceful municipal forest walking path through pine and oak woods near Ajloun Castle.
schedule.reason: Natural setting to start the day in shade, matching the history and culture theme.

schedule.name: Ajloun Castle
schedule.description: 12th-century Ayyubid fortress guarding against Crusader incursions and protecting local iron mines.
schedule.reason: Iconic medieval site that embodies Ajloun's historical heritage.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Ain Al-Tissis Lookout
schedule.description: Scenic mountain bend overlook above forested ravines along the upper Ajloun circuit.
schedule.reason: Brief scenic stop to enjoy panoramic views before lunch.

schedule.name: Ajloun Forest Reserve Restaurant
schedule.description: Scenic nature reserve restaurant serving organic, locally sourced Jordanian dishes.
schedule.reason: Fresh, local cuisine in a forest setting, aligning with the cultural theme.

schedule.name: Summaga Cafe & Restaurant
schedule.description: Farm-to-table organic eatery offering regional sumac dishes and local crafts.
schedule.reason: Light dinner to conclude the day with authentic flavors.

days.transport_notes: Come back to your hotel in Amman to sleep.

days.summary: Discover Jerash's heritage village, rural springs, and a seasonal waterfall before enjoying two delightful Jordanian meals.

schedule.name: Suf Village Heritage Center
schedule.description: Heritage village hub with traditional stone houses, crafts, and community tourism.
schedule.reason: Immersive cultural experience showcasing local traditions.

schedule.name: Al-Kittah Village and Springs
schedule.description: Rural village with springs, olive groves, and traditional farming.
schedule.reason: Showcases Jerash's natural and agricultural heritage.

schedule.name: Al-Karakhouf Waterfall
schedule.description: Seasonal spring waterfall in the green valley of Burma district.
schedule.reason: Natural highlight offering a refreshing break in the heat.

schedule.name: Jerash Canyon Restaurant
schedule.description: Canyon-side restaurant offering outdoor dining with gorge views.
schedule.reason: Midday meal with scenic surroundings, aligning with the cultural theme.

schedule.name: Green Valley Restaurant Jerash
schedule.description: Garden restaurant along the stream valley between Jerash and Dibbeen forest.
schedule.reason: Evening meal in a relaxed garden setting, perfect for winding down.

days.transport_notes: Come back to your hotel in Amman to sleep.

meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights=2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Jerash, Ajloun. Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: Jerash→cluster 0 (Jerash Governorate · culture, history); Ajloun→cluster 1 (Ajloun Governorate · history, culture)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Jerash part 1 → D2:C1/Ajloun → D3:C2/Jerash part 2
- mustVisit entity lock: (none)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C1: Ajloun Great Mosque + Ajloun Olive Press Museum; C1: Ajloun Biscuit House + Orjan Soap House Trailhead + RSCN Biscuit House; C2: South Decumanus + North Decumanus
- Lodging requested: rating=4 star, type=hotel. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): Celestia Boutique Inn [4-star]; N2(C1): Ajloun Hotel [2-star] (4-star unavailable in this area — say it is 2-star)
- Money: 800 JOD covers 4 traveller(s) for 3 days (≈266.667 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 2 night(s) x ~2 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority=budget → take the cheaper of two comparable options and note the saving. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.
